    new_opponent = opponent.copy()

def evaluate(you, opponent, move_count):
    # move_count = number of moves made so far (total discs on board - 4)
    total_discs = np.sum(you) + np.sum(opponent)
    empty = 64 - total_discs
    # game stage: early (empty > 40), mid (20-40), late (empty <= 20)

        your_moves = len(get_legal_moves(you, opponent))
        # swap positions to get opponent moves

        mobility_weight = 10
        positional_weight = 1
        disc_weight = 0
    elif empty > 20:

        opp_moves = len(get_legal_moves(opponent, you))

    # mobility score
